biggest_catch: The terms state the $50 offer may be changed at any time without notice, and bill credits have no cash value.
catches: Referrer must be a current Gexa Energy customer actively enrolled on a residential postpaid product; government accounts, corporations and other commercial accounts are excluded.
Referred friend must be new: not currently a Gexa Energy customer and not one within the previous 90 days.
Friend must enroll on a 12-month or longer postpaid product via the referrer's unique program-generated link; other enrollments are ineligible.
Referrer's $50 credit is issued after the friend pays their first invoice in full by the due date.
Friend's $50 credit is issued after they pay their first two invoices in full by the due dates.
One-time bill credits have no cash value; Gexa may change the offer or terminate the program at any time.
Gexa Energy is a Texas retail electric provider (NextEra Energy Resources family), USD.
Framed as savings on planned energy spending, never income.

steps: Be a current Gexa Energy customer on a residential postpaid product; open My Account > My Rewards & Referrals tab.
Enter your friend's information and send your unique referral link.
Friend clicks the link and enrolls on a 12-month or longer postpaid product.
Friend pays their first invoice in full by the due date; you receive a one-time $50 bill credit.
Friend pays their first two invoices in full by the due dates; they receive their $50 bill credit.
